post_text:
Day 2/30 — ValueTask vs Task Allocation Traps (.NET & C#)

Spotted a hot path in a code review generating thousands of dead Task objects per second during cache hits.

• **Heap Allocations:** Returning a Task allocates a reference type on the heap even when the result is already available synchronously.
• **GC Pressure:** High throughput APIs hit Gen0 collections hard from redundant state machine allocations.
• **ValueTask:** Struct-based wrapper eliminates the allocation overhead when results resolve instantly.

Watch out: Never await a ValueTask multiple times or consume it concurrently.

Where have you spotted unnecessary allocations in your hot paths?
